Zero. Zilch. Not a single HOT squeeze name on the board today. You gotta be kidding me! It’s been months since we’ve seen the squeeze radar go this cold. So what gives? Is this the calm before the storm, or has the market decided to take a breather after weeks of relentless rotations? Either way, the market is telling us something. Are we listening?

Here’s the deal: When the squeeze radar is quieter than a library at midnight, it’s not a signal to hibernate but rather to double down on observation. Risk is slowing, but **this is where patience becomes the ultimate edge.** We’ve been riding a wave of pockets of momentum—crypto bids, nuclear, and China tech names lighting up our books. But with no HOT reads and not a single name even registering in the WARM zone (75-90), the market’s saying, “Hey, maybe we’re entering an inflection point.” Rotation fatigue? Macro confusion? Timing recalibration? All possible. But today isn’t about forcing trades; it’s about positioning yourself for the next wave.

Zooming out, the macro picture still tilts neutral, maybe even leaning risk-on. Look at $BTCUSD grinding higher, energy names trying to claw back from oversold misery, and China tech ($NIO, $GDS, and $LI) refusing to stay down despite the noise overseas. Play the hand you’re dealt—there are no HOT setups right now, but that doesn’t mean there’s no game. The portfolio is fat with winners, and what’s fascinating is the diversity of leadership: nuclear, rare earths, crypto, and even a meme name ($GME) still managing to show resilience.

For late entries, here’s your cheat code: pivot toward what hasn’t maxed out its juice yet. $UAMY, $SMR, and $NNE are still sitting on potential for more upside within rare earths and nuclear, with squeezes simmering underneath. On the China beat, $GDS has been incredibly resilient off its lows and offers a tight, controlled risk-entry level for a second push higher. And in energy? Don’t sleep on $OXY or $APA—if crude wakes up, these could rocket. $AFRM in fintech is still a sleeper, up +54% from entry but with plenty left in the tank if we see risk appetite pick up again. And the bears? They’ve got nothing.

Looking ahead, the focus shifts to *reaction mode*. No HOT setups today doesn’t mean we’ll get the same story tomorrow morning. Keep a careful eye on crypto, where $ETH and $BTC are riding significant momentum. A breakout above $30k for $BTC? Forget about it—everything tied to digital assets ($COIN, $BMNR, $SBET) is going to explode. As for sectors, rare earths and uranium stay front and center. If China sneezes—or confirms stimulus buzz—names like $NIO and $LI become instant radar kings again.

Today’s not the day to click “buy” out of boredom. Stack your watchlists, protect your profits, and be ready. This is the reset. The market will show its hand soon—be ready when it does.
